zh.explain: 有志向和才气的人，追求功业，应当天天努力，从现在起就不要贪酒恋色。如果某天有喜讯传来，钱财福禄可以随你挑选。
divination: 一方面要心怀高远的志向，另一方面也要脚踏实地，安守自己的本分。
等到金鸡报语，喜讯来临，便没有不令人欢悦的事情了。
zh.summary: 此卦志气功名之象。所祈求之事宜坚守常态，则会非常吉祥。

verse: Rome was not built in a day.
Let no woman nor wine bury your way.
Rises to work when the golden rooster crows,
Money and fortune will soon be called.
interpretation: Determine your goals, keep at it.
The golden rooster calls and happiness will come.
meaning: Work hard to fulfill your ambitions.
Maintain things as-is and everything will turn out very well.
en.explain: Those with ambitions and talents, in pursuit of merits & accomplishments, should work diligently daily. From now on, they should stay away from alcohol and women. When good news comes, you can pick and choose your wealth and happiness.
divination: While you can have high aspirations, you also need to keep your feet firmly planted on the ground ie. be realistic, and do your duty. When the golden rooster brings good news, everything will be joyous and blissful.
items: Accumulate merits, pray for protection & blessings.

notes: 17 items: no 出门在外 / Travel item on either page; adds 迁徙搬家 / Migrating and moving house. zh keys differ from usual: 官司情况 (not 官司诉讼), 疾病情况 (not 治病健康), 畜养动物.
